host.observedModelPolicy: Use emitted runtime model if present; otherwise unverified. Configured defaults do not prove actual runtime model.

comparison.retryPolicy: Never retry attempted trials; interrupted/incomplete rows stay incomplete.
comparison.metrics: Whole-turn runtime tokens include host overhead; skill-only bytes are measured separately. Unknown telemetry remains null.

pilot.purpose: Infrastructure only; excluded from comparison and quality adoption.

isolation: Fresh temporary CWD, unchanged host settings, scoped prompt and post-observation event supervisor. Not a pre-execution security boundary. No detached handoff; parent launches and supervises full comparison.
capabilityLimits: Image tool availability and actual image file paths must be observed per trial; prompt responses cannot substitute for image output.
Browser observation requires explicit existing executable/module paths. Missing paths leave required rendered evidence unverified.
All selected private references are preloaded equally by scenario for candidate; no demand-loading or reference-efficiency claim.
Model identity and image-call classification are unverified when not exposed by events.
Independent rubric judgments are required; technical observations never self-certify visual quality.
authorityAmendment: Before any model response, parent /root requested alignment of the harness prohibition with F09 authorization: exempt only the specifically requested existing image-generation tool within the existing call budget; permit that tool to save its own returned primary images at tool-managed paths. Manual/product edits stay within workspace. No general web, downloads, installs, uploads, substitute images, extra generations or other external-service permission.
preservation: Original plan, runner snapshot, candidate/baseline bodies, private references, common facts, rubric, schedule, first pilot marker and all failed-pilot bytes remain unchanged. Original plan remains the archival record; this append-only active plan binds the authority-corrected runner. No model output existed before this correction.
execution: Only parent may launch the one corrected pilot using the existing infrastructure-amendment interface through exec_command require_escalated. Full comparison remains unstarted. Runtime telemetry additionally binds the exact active runner hash.
processObservation: One sampler pass in flight; overlapping ticks skipped. No full-host /proc enumeration. Traverse only observed owned process/task child lists with count/time guards, retain scan/cleanup failures as incomplete, and clean only identities still matching observed ownership.

continuation.authority: Parent /root explicitly authorized ONE infrastructure replacement of incomplete F01 baseline in a new complete 66-row amended comparison after sampler fixes and controls, before any candidate result existed. All other 65 rows are first attempts. No further retries, source/rubric/model/quality budget changes, or semantic-result selection.
continuation.rationale: The known harness queued unbounded whole-host process scans; child exited but supervisor could not finalize telemetry/summary. Parent stopped its exact identified supervisor and preserved raw events, partial workspace and receipts. This replacement repairs infrastructure before candidate evidence, not selection of a preferred semantic response.
continuation.adoptionEligibility: No current adoption result. The old attempted row remains incomplete and excluded from the new complete matched run. The parent assesses whether the new 66-row run and all independent checks satisfy the original rubric; missing or failed new rows cannot be replaced automatically.

preservationRule: All prior plans/runner snapshots, frozen sources, common scope, rubric and schedule are byte-bound and unchanged. Active model prompts are byte-identical to the previous authority-amended runner for the same paths. Runtime defaults remain unchanged. Parent launches and supervises; helper invokes no model.

preLaunchReportingAmendment.reason: Expose process-observation failures/residuals directly in independent reviewer context, in addition to retained telemetry and summary. No model prompt, source, rubric, schedule or task-budget change.
